# third_party

- `kumorfm_repro/`: vendored from https://github.com/T-Lab/OpenRFM (MIT), `implementation/kumorfm_repro`,
  commit of 2026-10-02 clone. Only `model.py` / `data.py` / `icl_eval.py` are used (model definition +
  checkpoint loader). Weights: `weights/openrfm/openrfm-pretrain-ctx96.pt` from the v0.1.0 GitHub release.
